construction_stages.visible: Keel and both stems, five alternating frames at u=-0.8,-0.4,0,0.4,0.8; trestles remain visible.

repair_contract.work_option: false/omitted disables repair variant; -1 selects local -X; any other truthy value selects local +X.
repair_contract.plank_states: setGapPlank(null/undefined/false) hides plank; numeric0 shows straight plank angled outward0.5rad, numeric1 fits hull; smoothstep interpolates geometry.

leaks.side_mirroring: LEAKS.sx is multiplied by work-selected side

repair_contract.point_coordinate_contract: point() returns world coordinates by applying hull.matrixWorld; hull is translated up KEEL_Y=0.42 inside the prop.
repair_contract.collision: Source rectangle half extents hx=0.9 with work, otherwise1.04; hz=3.30. Solid grounded prop, not a floating vessel.
repair_contract.no_unjustified_walkability: Source does not promise a standing player route through an open construction frame. Intentional repair gap and incomplete stages must not be reported as accidental damage.

mirroring_invariants.drip_height: hull-localY=-KEEL_Y; after hull translation, prop-localY=0, then prop world transform applies.

geometry_contract.source_comment_geometry_caveat: The source comment intends keel top0.38m above water, but hullSpine uses0.09×0.15m beams centered about hull-localY=-0.07. Combined with inversion and translationY0.31, the actual midship keel can reach about0.455m. This is an analytical source-code discrepancy, not a measured mesh bounding box. A delivered asset placing its real keel top0.38m must document the scantling/placement change and derive its seat from the delivered support surface.

rescue_contract.seat_calculation: boat.js loops t in0.01 increments until hullPt(0,t,+1).x>=0.4; t=.27, hull surfaceY=.10452324, seatY=round(.38-.07-surfaceY-.02,3)=.185.
